title: Cloud IAM Access Key Created
description: A new programmatic IAM access key was created, a common persistence technique.
remediation: Verify key creation with the IAM principal owner; revoke unauthorized keys and rotate secrets.

title: Cloud Root Account Login Without MFA
description: Successful root account console authentication without multi-factor authentication.
remediation: Immediately lock root console access, enable hardware MFA, and audit all CloudTrail events from this session.
